{{Quote|Aegis Base is a converted security station&mdash;heavily fortified with as many turrets as soldiers.|Nedecca|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Aegis Base''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] installation in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Cipher Nine]] infiltrated Aegis Base and planted beacons for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] bombers to use in a bombing run against the facility.
